name: Central Spears (BB)
disable: A hero must succeed at a DC 18 Thievery check check on the triggering floor tiles or the wall sockets in the western wall.
reset: The central spears reset after 1 minute.

items.name: Spear Barrage
items.text: When a creature moves into any of the squares in the outlined area, the trap shoots three spears from the western wall. It makes one ranged Strike against the westernmost creature in each row.
